title: To require group health plans and group or individual health insurance coverage to provide coverage for over-the-counter contraceptives.
latestAction: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on Education and Workforce, and Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
